editorial:
Imagine a guy who is a terrifying street thug one day and a famous movie star the next. You get to follow the wild life of Bindon, a tough guy from the underworld who actually makes it big in the acting world. He spends his time hanging out with rich socialites and living a fancy life, but he still has that mean streak. The vibe is a mix of glitzy parties and gritty street fights, showing you how weird it is when two completely different worlds collide in the middle of London.

You will love the lead performance because it feels real and scary at the same time. The pacing keeps you moving, though some of the romantic scenes feel a bit slow. If you enjoy stories about people who try to change their lives but fail, you should definitely check this out. To get the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video so you can see all the detail in those old-school sets. If you are a movie buff, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for the bonus features.
endingExplained: The movie ends with Bindon realizing he can never truly escape his old life. Despite the fame and the money, his violent nature takes over again. He ends up back in the criminal world, losing his acting career and his fancy friends. The final scenes show him broken and alone, proving that you cannot just flip a switch to stop being a criminal. He ends up exactly where he started, just older and more tired.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime stories and movies about fame.
